newsitem.title: UK: Pearson down after cautious comment.
newsitem.headline: Pearson down after cautious comment.

text.p: Shares in Pearson Plc dipped on Tuesday, erasing Monday's gains after cautious press comment ahead of a statement said to be due from the media and leisure group on Wednesday.
The stock was down 7-1/2p at 693-1/2 by 1335 GMT in modest volume of 386,666 shares.
A report in the Financial Times, owned by Pearson, noted Monday's share price rise but said the company was "concerned about too much hope creeping into the share price."
It said the company was to issue a statement tomorrow giving the first indication of trading in the key second-half period.
Pearson shares reached a record 782p in late October amid bid speculation and restructuring talk following the appointment of Marjorie Scardino as chief executive.
Scardino formally takes up her new post in January.
